description: This file defines instrumentation and event handling for SDK objects within the Playwright core server, including classes, interfaces, and functions for managing event listeners and SDK object lifecycle events.

classes.name: SdkObject
classes.description: Represents an SDK object with attribution and instrumentation, extending EventEmitter for event handling.

methods.name: createRootSdkObject
methods.description: Creates a root SDK object with a fake parent, used as the starting point for SDK object hierarchy.

methods.name: createInstrumentation
methods.description: Creates a proxy-based instrumentation object that manages event listeners and dispatches SDK lifecycle events.
